file_id: Shri Amit Kumar & Anr vs Unknown on 15 July, 2024

sentences.text: Shri Amit Kumar & Anr vs Unknown on 15 July, 2024

Author: Soumen Sen Bench: Soumen Sen  Court No. 29 CRM (A) 1895 of 2024  (266041)
 c  15.07.2024 In re: An application for anticipatory bail under S  the Code of Criminal Procedure correspondin  (AD 73) 482 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhit  connection with Cyber Crime P.S. FIR No. 42  (S. Banerjee)
 dated 23.12.2023 under Section 420/406/120B  Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Soumen Sen  Court No. 29 CRM (A) 1895 of 2024  (266041)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In the matter of: Shri Amit Kumar & Anr.
 
 Mr. Sourav Mukherjee  Mr. Mohit Kumar  Mr. Kumar Sanu Chowdhary  ... f  Ms. Amita Gaur  Mr. Dattatreya Dutta  
 1.

In view of the fact that the petitioners have cooperated with the investigation and has provided necessary documents and have undertaken to produce further documents and having regard to the nature of the dispute between the parties, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners may not be necessary.

2. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.20,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local,
to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Signed By :
SWARUP BANERJEE High Court of Calcutta 18 th of July 2024 12:23:41 PM Shri Amit Kumar & Anr vs Unknown on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162893603/
1

entities.text: SWARUP BANERJEE High Court of Calcutta
entities.label: JUDGE

sentences.text: The petitioners shall meet the I.O. once in a fortnight till the submission of the final report.

3. It is further directed that the petitioners shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
4.
Accordingly, the application for anticipatory bail is disposed of.
5. The progress report of the investigation is taken on record.
6. All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
Shri Amit Kumar & Anr vs Unknown on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162893603/
